name: Souma Manami
source:
The elite teacher with lots of trust from the school. She is a tough woman with a hardened personality. Not only does she posseses a great deal of work ability, she also has a lot of pride.

Despite her rigorous work ethics, she still has a gentle face for her students. Her coursework has a good reputation for efficiency and understanding.

She rarely gets into trouble, so she has a hard time dealing with it when it happens.
